title: Changed-Mind Restocking Schedule Applied to Northgate Marketplace Unrefunded-Return Claims
content:
**Northgate changed-mind restocking schedule — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** The restocking allowance, taken from the amount claimed for an unrefunded return, is a percentage of the price paid for the requested units following Northgate's changed-mind restocking schedule: where the request gives the reason change of mind and was made no more than 14 calendar days after the order's delivered date, it is half the program's maximum restocking percentage; where the reason is change of mind and the request was made later, it is the program's maximum restocking percentage; where the reason is any other, it is zero.

| Reason on the return request | Request date | Restocking percentage of the price paid |
|---|---|---|
| change of mind | no more than 14 calendar days after the order's delivered date | half the program's maximum restocking percentage |
| change of mind | 15 or more calendar days after the delivered date | the program's maximum restocking percentage |
| any other reason | any date | zero |

**Program maxima and their halves.**

| Seller program | Maximum restocking percentage | Half of it |
|---|---|---|
| Seller-Fulfilled | 20 percent | 10 percent |
| Pro Seller | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Fulfilled by Northgate | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Freight Seller | 15 percent | 7.5 percent |
| Certified Renewed | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| International Seller | 20 percent | 10 percent |

**Day count (hypothetical delivered date Monday 10 March 2031).** A change-of-mind request dated 24 March 2031 is 14 calendar days after delivery and takes the half percentage; one dated 25 March 2031 is 15 days after and takes the full percentage.

**Hypothetical figure.** On a Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled order where the price paid for the requested units is USD 200.00, an early change-of-mind request takes 10 percent, that is 20.00, a later one 20 percent, that is 40.00, and a defective-item request nothing.
